1. write the question before the answer

turn every title in your notes into a question.
then cover the page and answer it.

2. mix your subjects

an hour of history, then maths.
switching keeps your brain awake.

3. turn facts into stories

this morning i learned that victor hugo's novel the hunchback of notre-dame turned the real cathedral into a national icon.
i'll never forget the date: 1831.

3. turn facts into stories

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that victor hugo's novel the hunchback of notre-dame turned the real cathedral into a national icon.
i'll never forget the date: 1831.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. study where you'll take the exam

or somewhere just as quiet.
your brain likes familiar places.

5. end every session with a summary

three sentences, from memory.
what you can't write, you don't know yet.
save this for your next exam.
